description: Defines error handling classes and error stream templates for EGL and ANGLE project, including egl::Error class, error codes, and macros for error checking.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Encapsulates EGL error code, message, and related information, with methods for error checking and message retrieval.

classes.name: ErrorStreamBase
classes.description: Template class for creating error stream objects associated with specific error codes.

methods.name: Error::NoError
